subject: Refine AWS Marketplace hero pitch + localized pricing notes
messages:
From: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@marketplace-partner.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Listing Specialist <aws-listing@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace hero + localized pricing — draft for review

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached are the first-pass assets we promised: a hero copy draft and a pricing matrix with US/EU localized examples. Our PM at Acme (Sara) asked us to move quickly — they want the listing live in the next 3 weeks if possible.

Two asks to start:
- Can you review the hero blurb and suggest any changes so it aligns with Redwood's tone and buyer focus (platform vs. model)?
- Do the pricing examples look right from your side for the US region? We included EU ranges but we know there may be differences in regional SKUs and billing footnotes.

Attachments: hero_draft_v1.docx; pricing_matrix_US_EU.xlsx; locale_strings_v1.csv

If it's easier, feel free to mark up the doc and send back. I'm flexible for a 30-min sync later today if that helps.

Best,
Emma
Emma Hayes | Partner Programs 
Marketplace Partner Co.

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@marketplace-partner.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace hero + localized pricing — draft for review

Thanks Emma — got the files. Looping in Kimberly for voice/UX and Marissa for GTM/field messaging; Aditya will confirm billing/footnote language.

Quick notes up front (I put inline comments in hero_draft_v1):
- Overall tone: lean harder into "predictable inference economics" and "deployment flexibility" (one short line each). Buyers searching marketplace care about "cost per token / predictable throughput" — avoid deep technical jargon in the hero.
- Lead sentence: suggest flipping from feature-first to outcome-first. Current: "High-performance inference engine for LLMs." -> Proposed: "Deliver predictable, low-latency LLM inference at cloud scale."
- CTA: we should prefer a single CTA: "Try a hosted endpoint" with a secondary link to "Request Dedicated" — Amazon prefers single primary CTAs in the hero region.

Pricing matrix: two quick asks for Aditya — confirm whether the SKU examples can map to our existing metering model (per-token + embedding unit). Also confirm whether EU ranges should include estimated VAT flags or if we leave that to the seller portal footnotes.

Kimberly / Marissa / Aditya — can you review the attached and drop comments in the doc by 2pm PT so Emma and Acme can get unblocked?

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@marketplace-partner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 14:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace hero + localized pricing — draft for review

Hey team — thanks for the draft, Emma. I left tracked comments in hero_draft_v1.docx, summarized below so nothing gets missed in the doc review: 

Summary of copy edits (high level):
- Hero headline: use Sergio's proposed outcome-first lead. Shorten to 7–10 words for scanability. Example: "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference at scale."
- Subhead: clarify who benefits: "For product teams building LLM features — lower latency, predictable cost, and flexible deployment."
- Benefit bullets: reduce to three, start each with an outcome verb: "Reduce per-token cost with caching and batching", "Maintain SLA-backed throughput with Dedicated capacity", "Deploy privately across VPC and on-prem".
- Tone: stay technical but accessible; avoid internal terms like "KV cache" in hero bullets — keep those for the technical details section lower on the page.

CTA/UX: agree a single primary CTA. For marketplace listing we recommend: primary "Try Hosted API"; secondary link in microsite area: "Talk to Sales / Request Dedicated".

Localization notes:
- Pricing: the matrix looks fine for US list prices. For EU we should show an example with VAT callout, not a hard number ("€X + VAT"), because VAT handling varies per buyer.
- Strings file: I updated locale_strings_v1.csv with a tighter hero copy for en-US and en-GB. Emma — if you want, I can export a QA-ready CSV for the seller portal.

Operational ask: Marissa, can you confirm the co-sell asset set (one-pager + 2-minute demo script) is available to attach to the listing? If not, we'll prioritize the one-pager. Marissa?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if Acme wants a quick sign-off.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park | Head of Marketplace Content & Field Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Hayes <emma.hayes@marketplace-partner.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, AWS Listing Specialist <aws-listing@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace hero + localized pricing — draft for review

Perfect — thank you all for the quick turn. We'll pull Kimberly's suggested hero and your locale CSV into the seller portal today.

Marissa — Acme confirmed they'd like the one-pager attached and a short co-sell enablement call next Wednesday with their field. Can you confirm availability and a recommended 30-min agenda?

Aditya — please flag any mandatory billing footnotes we need before we submit (VAT, metering footnotes). We want to avoid a resubmission cycle.

I updated the Drive link with Kimberly's CSV and a revised pricing tab (pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx). I'll send the portal submission note to AWS Listing Specialist after we get Marissa/Aditya bits.

Thanks — on track for portal submission later today if we get those confirmations.

Best,
Emma
Marketplace Partner Co.
